name: ACFHP annual project funding
summary: Annual request for proposals funding on-the-ground restoration and conservation of habitat for coastal, estuarine-dependent and diadromous fish along the US Atlantic coast, paid from federal National Fish Habitat Partnership funds with a required non-federal match.

status.quote: Timeline: This RFP has now closed.

deadline.quote: Applications must be received by 5:00 pm Eastern time on Friday, September 25th, 2026.

geography.quote: to restore and conserve habitat necessary to support coastal, estuarine-dependent, and diadromous fish species along the U.S. Atlantic Coast.

access.quote: The Atlantic Coastal Fish Habitat Partnership (ACFHP) is requesting project applications to restore and conserve habitat necessary to support coastal, estuarine-dependent, and diadromous fish species along the U.S. Atlantic Coast.

amount.quote: We anticipate funding to support 2-3 projects ranging from$35,000 - $100,000, although funds awarded per project are typically lower than $100,000.

co_finance_required.quote: successful proposals should demonstrate a minimum 1:1 non-federal match.
